title: Representable quotients at the signed integer boundary
summary: The quotient of Integer.MIN_VALUE by itself now reduces to one. Two representations of the same negative divisor also produced the same exact reduced pair.

change.description: Fraction division reduces the two products before checking whether the resulting numerator and positive denominator fit in int.

notes: Dividing the first divisor’s numerator and denominator by two gives the second representation exactly.
